name: Lightkeeper's burst scales with attack power (#2021)
contract: Lightkeeper 560835 proc-triggers Lightbringer 561277, whose damage its description states as $561277m1 plus 22% of attack power. The helper carries a flat 100 and had no spell_bonus_data row, so SpellDamageBonusDone added no attack power term at all. Against a fixed base of 1000 the unmodified calculation returns 800 for a level 80 Templar; with the coefficient and about 445 attack power it must clear 850.
